notes: A new glass look (Settings → Home & appearance → Style, Classic still there), a tidier TiviMate-style guide, and a side menu that tucks away when you're not using it. In Live TV, Left shows the channels over the picture and Left again the groups in their place; the guide and Live TV keep the same group. Search finds titles however they're typed (spiderman, pokemon), live channels keep retrying when a provider refuses them, and a playback log (Settings → Playback) helps track down streams that fail.
